reason: Expert provides a troubleshooting rule and post-upgrade check for microwave links where firmware 1.4 resets ATPC.

knowledge.summary: After a firmware upgrade on these microwave links, the ATPC setting is reset to off, which can cause severe fading during rain; check and re-enable ATPC after upgrades.
knowledge.author: Jari Jänne
knowledge.details: Firmware 1.4 upgrade resets ATPC setting to off.
